keyFindings.description: An unchanged consumer breaks: the stand-in daemon builds its GET /legion/v1/state document with a literal and parses it at module load with LegionStateResponse.parse; contract 15 makes `capabilities` a required member of that strict object (packages/contracts/src/legion-api.ts:233-241), the literal has none, so the parse throws before the stand-in binds its port. Reproduced with the repo's own schema from packages/pi-legion (safeParse → invalid_type at path capabilities; with `capabilities: []` it parses). Breaks the grant rig (scripts/grant-rig/README.md procedure) and the skill-scenario rig (scripts/skill-scenarios/rig.sh:673), neither of which CI starts (run.test.ts imports helpers only). Fix: add `capabilities: [],` to the STATE literal — the daemon's MarshalJSON emits [] for an empty report (internal/api/state.go).

Both say the image build's OK line reads `model-fallback=off`; it reads `on`: Oh My Pi 18.6.0 defaults retry.modelFallback to true and the build runs with no operator overlay (Worker Image runs 37736231904 and 37737281790 printed `model-fallback=on`; the tester's documentationFeedback). Carry the wording fix in the corrective push.
`legion state` is said to carry the capability report; the text renderer (cmd/legion/main.go runState) prints no capabilities — only `legion state --json` does. Say `--json`.

No `## Contract change census` for a diff that adds refusals and a required field at process boundaries: api.State.capabilities required by the strict plugin reader (rolled out by the daemonApiVersion 15 bump both sides), the probe pod's refusal of an OK line without capabilities=checked (probe.go:509), legion probe-image exit 1 on a missing image capability (the Worker Image build gate), capabilities.decided.<unknown> refused (config.go:928), bootprobe.OKLine and sandbox.ProbeImage signatures. The reviewer enumerated the consumers (review body); the implementer writes the census into the body with the search commands so the next round re-runs them.

securityLine: Security: supply-chain — Go 1.26.8 pinned by ARG + SHA-256 d0f743b3… checked with the other archives before unpack (worker.Dockerfile:62, 282-285; re-downloaded here, sum matches); gopls go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@v0.23.0 in golang:1.26.8-alpine (worker.Dockerfile:218); typescript 5.9.3 / typescript-language-server 6.0.1 / pyright 1.1.414 exact npm pins with registry integrity, no lockfile, no --ignore-scripts (worker.Dockerfile:82-84, 293 — hardening); chromium, python3, curl, wget from trixie, the suite as pin (worker.Dockerfile:431); no Action or base-image digest changed. untrusted-input — the probe runs binaries resolved from the pod's env (PATH, PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH, the operator's runtime.kubernetes.pod.env) with exec, no shell on the value (image.go:181-199, 381-401), quoted output capped at 300 chars (image.go:68); Launch is shell-parsed under sh -c (image.go:373-375) from the probe's own --omp/LEGION_OMP_PATH, no outside party. sandbox — probe log tail 50→100 lines (probe.go:48) under the same 64 KiB cap (probe.go:439); no manifest, capability or network policy changed. authz — capabilities.decided is a new key of the operator's own legion.yaml (config.go:928-971); no route, grant or tool changed. agent-def — skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md gain report-the-gap text read against the code; neither touches a reviewer or tester prompt. No secret, prompt or transport surface.
